conceptZh: 扭蛋小怪獸從膠囊蹦出，跟一個「也」形的小夥伴拔河，把左邊的單人旁拉過來合體成「他」。
object: a round fuzzy pocket creature toy bursting out of a gachapon capsule, with a gold capsule half and two tiny creature friends
morph: a person-radical stroke group on the left and the 也 shape on the right get pulled apart by two creatures, then spring together into the glyph 他
creativeAngle: 拔河：左邊的「亻」和右邊的「也」被兩隻小怪獸各拉一邊，彈合成字；「他們」用三隻小怪獸排排揮手呼應。
promptEn: An 8-second bouncy cartoon clip on a clean solid pale lemon backdrop, with a single large Traditional Chinese glyph 他 as the only text, built in saturated violet, glossy rounded strokes, about 70% of frame height, centered with margins. Lead: a round fuzzy pocket creature toy with stubby feet, bursting from a gold-and-clear gachapon capsule and bouncing off everything; at most one helper, a second tiny creature in a different color. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Voice: warm, friendly off-screen narrator, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 他、他、他們 (ㄊㄚ、ㄊㄚ、ㄊㄚ ㄇㄣ˙), slowly with clear tones, then stops. Moment 1 (0–1.6s): the capsule pops open with a bright pop-pop and the fuzzy creature rockets out, pinballing off the floor and walls, ears flapping, while the first 他 is spoken and a violet slim vertical stroke with a short diagonal drops in on the left. Moment 2 (1.6–3.4s): the creature spots the other half, the 也 shape sitting far on the right, and the two halves drift apart; it grabs the left half with its mouth, the tiny second creature grabs the right half, and they tug-of-war, both bodies stretching long as noodles, eyes squeezed shut. Moment 3 (3.4–5s): the second 他 is spoken as both creatures let go at once, the halves boing together with a rubbery snap, and the creatures fly backward and bounce off the sides of the frame, tumbling. Moment 4 (5s): as 他們 is spoken, the capsule spits out a third tiny creature and the three line up like a row of fuzzy dumplings, all waving a stubby arm at the glyph, one fur ball leaning too far and toppling over into the others. Final 5–8s: the glyph 他 sits perfectly still, fully formed, left stroke group and right hooked part clearly separated; the three creatures to one side bounce gently in sync, with no contact with the strokes. Soft daylight, gentle contrast, no flashing, no real people, no extra writing anywhere.

conceptZh: 豬探長發現一顆亮晶晶的線索彈珠，衝過去卻踩到它，像彈珠台一樣在地板、天花板、牆壁、披風英雄的頭上連彈五下，每彈一下就「喀」地敲進「他」的一筆，最後一彈正好坐上長長的豎彎鉤尾端，再滑到放大鏡上當椅子。
object: a stout cartoon detective pig in a checked deerstalker hat with an oversized magnifying glass, plus one caped action-figure hero whose cape keeps flopping over his head
morph: five pinball bounces, each hit clacks one stroke of 他 into place: floor (left falling stroke of 亻), ceiling (vertical of 亻), right wall (horizontal-turn-hook of 也), hero's head (middle vertical of 也), final landing (long bottom vertical-bend-hook of 也)
creativeAngle: 全新的彈跳連鎖結構，取代上一版的拔河與聚光燈：五次彈跳剛好對應「他」的五筆，每一下撞擊都看得見、聽得見筆畫敲進定位，筆順從左偏旁到右邊「也」依序完成，結構不會被犧牲。披風英雄只當第四個彈墊，不搶戲；「他們」這個詞由豬探長和英雄並排互指來演出，聲音與畫面同一個故事。豬探長最後坐在放大鏡上而非筆畫上，定格時字形乾淨不被遮擋。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright cartoon clip on a clean solid pale mint backdrop with nothing behind. The only text on screen is one large Traditional Chinese glyph 他, built from chunky glossy deep-cobalt-blue strokes, filling about 70% of frame height, centered with clear margins. Lead: a stout cartoon detective pig in a checked deerstalker hat, carrying a round magnifying glass far bigger than his own head, who charges at every clue at full speed. One supporting character only: a small caped action-figure hero whose cape is three sizes too long and keeps flopping over his face. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no real people.

Voice: a warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 他、他、他們 (ㄊㄚ、ㄊㄚ、ㄊㄚ ㄇㄣ˙), reading exactly those syllables slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops.

0 to 1.5s: the pig stands at the far left, spots a tiny glinting marble clue on the floor far right, gasps, points his giant magnifying glass at it and winds up with a wiggle of his hind legs. The first 他 is spoken as he charges across the frame, hat flapping. He steps straight onto the marble, skids, and rockets up off the floor with a BOING; that first floor bounce clacks the short left-falling stroke of 亻 into place at the left of the glyph area.

1.5 to 3.5s: pinball chain. He smacks the ceiling, squashes flat like a pancake, and the vertical stroke of 亻 drops straight down beside the first stroke with a wooden clack. He ricochets into the right wall, splats, and the horizontal-turn-hook of 也 snaps in at the upper right. The caped hero zooms in from the top right, cape flopping over his face so he cannot see, and the pig bounces squarely off the top of his head with a hollow BONK; the hero spins like a top and the middle vertical stroke of 也 clacks down. The second 他 is spoken on that head bounce as the strokes visibly lock in.

3.5 to 5s: the pig's last bounce carries him in a big arc down toward the bottom of the glyph, where the long bottom vertical-bend-hook of 也 slides in beneath him like a sled; he rides along it, teeters on the curled hook tip, then slips off to the right and lands with a soft plop sitting on his magnifying glass, which lies flat like a round stool beside the glyph. The hero crash-lands upside down next to him in a heap of cape, legs kicking.

5 to 8s, final hold: the finished glyph 他 stays perfectly still, centered and fully readable, with 亻 on the left and 也 on the right clearly separated, nothing touching or covering the strokes. The word 他們 is spoken exactly as the pig and the hero sit side by side to the right of the glyph: the hero yanks his cape off his face, and the two point at each other with big proud grins, then the pig hugs his magnifying glass and the hero's cape flops back over his head one more time. Soft even daylight, saturated strokes against the light backdrop, no neon, no flashing, no extra writing anywhere.
